Method of Attack: Ransomware attack encrypting files and demanding ransom via RyukReadMe.html ransom notes
Discoverer: Colin Cowie of Red Flare Security
Impacted Systems: City of New Orleans network and systems
Attack Vector: Malicious executable files (yoletby.exe, v2.exe) executed on victim machines
Indicators of Compromise: Memory dumps uploaded to VirusTotal containing references to New Orleans and Ryuk
HERMES file marker and .ryk file extensions
References to domain names, domain controllers, internal IP addresses, user names, and file shares related to City of New Orleans
Presence of executables yoletby.exe and v2.exe
